suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: Add note that TDD RED/GREEN steps are optional for non-code changes (git/config-only features like .gitignore edits, YAML CI files). Two separate workers flagged this gap.
suggestedGuidanceUpdates.evidence: Features unignore-cargo-lock and setup-ci-pipeline both noted the rust-worker skill mandates TDD but the deliverable was a git/config change, not Rust code. Workers correctly skipped RED/GREEN phases.

suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: Clarify guidance for app/-only changes that can't be tested on desktop: specify when to extract testable logic to a workspace crate vs when cargo +esp check alone is sufficient.
suggestedGuidanceUpdates.evidence: Feature app-mqtt-rate-limit-and-url-validation had no tests added because mqtt_client.rs depends on esp-hal. Worker correctly used cargo +esp check, but the skill could be more explicit about this workflow.
